details.description: Discover the unique and delightful taste of Bovonto, a carbonated soft drink that offers a perfect balance of classic sweetness and a captivating flavour profile. Crafted with the finest ingredients, Bovonto combines fruity notes with a hint of spices, creating a refreshing and fizzy drinking experience that is perfect for quenching your thirst on a hot day or enjoying as a special treat. Close your eyes and experience the happiness that comes from the perfect balance of fizziness and authentic flavour. Bovonto is a beverage that stands out from the rest, offering a delightful and memorable drinking experience that your guests will love. Whether you're looking to enjoy it on its own or as part of a gathering, one glass of Bovonto is never enough.
details.ingredients: Carbonated Water, Sugar, Citric Acid E330, And Contains Permitted Natural Colour 150D And Synthetic Food Colour E133, 122, 124, 102, Contain Permitted Class Ii Preservatives E211
details.storageInstructions:
*Store in a cool and dry place
*Tastes best when chilled

details.description: Indulge in the captivating essence of Kalimark Paneer, a truly unique and refreshing beverage that celebrates the rich cultural heritage of rose-infused drinks. Crafted with the finest rose petals and infused with a creamy paneer texture, this carbonated soda offers a delightful and aromatic experience that tantalises the taste buds. Rooted in Indian culinary traditions, Kalimark Paneer delivers a gentle yet robust flavour, transporting you to a realm of nostalgia and refreshment. Quench your thirst with this delightful soda, perfect for any occasion, whether enjoyed chilled on a hot summer day or paired with your favourite meal. Immerse yourself in the distinct taste of rose petals and the creamy paneer, creating a truly memorable and satisfying drink experience.

Who doesnt like something that tastes ginger-ry? Kalimark Ginger gives the drink a healthy and a poised taste that makes the drink taste more like ginger soda. The carbonated soda mixed with the taste of ginger essence makes the drink strong. Under the circumstances of indigestion, Ginger soda is the best drink that one should hold on to. The ginger taste will enhance body mobility by making a healthy improvement for the throat and stomach. Kalimark was established in the year 1916, as a manufacturer and supplier of carbonated and non-carbonated drinks. Mr R. Palani Raj is the CEO of the organization at Tirunelveli under whose headship we have scaled new heights of success. His industrious efforts have assisted us in standing among the key Flavoured Carbonated Soft Drinks and Non-Carbonated Fruit Flavoured Drinks.
